title: Shelved books
passage: A. Books have been stacked on the floor. B. Several rows of books are arranged on a shelf. C. A bookcase is being carried outside. D. A person is seated beside a plant.
passageZh:
A. 書本被堆在地板上。
B. 數排書本排列在書架上。
C. 有人正把書架搬到外面。
D. 一個人坐在植物旁。
